proof_contract.kernel_majorant: The positive Xi cosine kernel gives sup_|z|=R |Xi(z)| <= Xi(iR)=xi(1/2+R).
proof_contract.dft_alias_identity: The N-point DFT coefficient at exponent 2n equals the true coefficient plus sum_{l>=1} c_(2n+lN) r^(lN).
proof_contract.interval_policy: Every raw DFT ball is enlarged symmetrically by the analytic alias bound before any quotient is formed.

scope.proved_if_pass: The exact H803 factorial threshold for the true Xi coefficients for every integer 2<=n<=126.
does_not_prove: the H803 tail n>=127 (supplied separately by H1319/H920)
